caption:
Most missed calls never get a callback.

Quo (formerly OpenPhone) tracked 16.7 million missed business calls over three months. Professional services, the largest sample in the study, returned only 33% of them.

Healthcare finished on top across every industry tested. They still left three of every five missed calls unanswered.

Find your own number this week:
Pull last month's call log.
Count the missed calls.
Count how many got a callback within 24 hours.
Divide the second by the first.

That percentage is what your ad budget funds.
